perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Kinder Morgan and partners reached final investment decision on the Western Gateway system, a proposed 1,300-mile refined-products network with 230,000 bpd design capacity; KMI holds 35.1% and contributes existing SFPP assets.

The project is an execution-backed expansion signal because it has moved beyond proposal to FID, but the retained August disclosure remains the newest material issuer source found in the bounded check.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: FID improves project certainty, while realized value still depends on construction, regulatory/permitting execution, capital discipline and throughput economics.
Existing-asset contribution can lower greenfield intensity, but returns should be tested against incremental earnings and capital required rather than design capacity alone.

sources.use: project FID, ownership and design-capacity evidence

lineage.searchStrategy: bounded issuer-domain check; retained newest material project-execution source without manufacturing novelty
